creative_brief.emotional_promise: A sleeping fox turns one gentle nudge into a tiny moonlit chase, then returns the crescent to calm.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A one-piece desk rocker needs only one compact card: the front establishes identity, inventory, and upright setup; the reverse carries the entire nudge, settle, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety sequence without a phone or website.
teaching_arc: Recognize the fox and its moonlit rocking promise
Confirm the one-piece inventory and no-assembly state
Locate the curved tail track and stand the crescent upright
Nudge lightly, release, and let gravity settle the fox
Reset upright and troubleshoot the surface or stance
Inspect, clean, store, and use the desk object safely
typography: Bitstream Vera Sans Bold for display and action hierarchy
Bitstream Vera Sans Roman and Oblique for instruction and voice
creative_brief.visual_motif: Moonlit orbit arcs echo the curled tail and crescent window, while exact product imagery shifts from dimensional unboxing view to upright motion diagram.

findings: The first page hero panel obscured part of the title and tagline, while the lower setup panel crowded its second instruction.
The first-render motion cards showed the dimensional print-stance image rather than an upright tail-contact view, making the rocking orientation and lateral nudge ambiguous.
The page-two subtitle was partly hidden by the cards and the surface-variation note became faint in grayscale.
resolved_changes: Reflowed page one with a smaller lower hero panel and a taller setup panel so every title and instruction has clear space.
Derived an exact front-profile diagram from the sealed STL and added a desk baseline, labeled tail track, lateral nudge arrow, and separate settling poses.
Lowered the motion cards below the subtitle and enlarged the surface-and-print-quality limitation in high-contrast bold text.
